source_title: Arizona Secretary of State — 1966 official canvass
source_notes: 1966 regular Arizona gubernatorial election. County and statewide cells transcribed from page 2 of the official canvass issued by the Arizona Secretary of State (1966-11-28); every candidate's county cells sum to the printed statewide TOTAL, and the statewide totals also match Wikipedia's results table (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1966_Arizona_gubernatorial_election). Every cell was first transcribed from RightDataUSA's county page and then checked against the canvass with no differences. La Paz County did not exist until 1983, so results are for the 14 counties then in existence and Yuma is the larger pre-1983 Yuma County. Election-wide registration, ballots cast and turnout are the official figures from page 1 of the canvass. The canvass PDF was supplied by the project maintainer and is retained with its SHA-256.
